## 📋 Gmail Inbound Auto-Reply Setup (Tiếng Việt)

### 1. Tạo OAuth Credentials cho Gmail
1. Vào Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials
2. Tạo **OAuth 2.0 Client ID** (Application type: Web application)
3. Authorized redirect URIs: `https://your-n8n-domain.com/rest/oauth2-credential/callback`
4. Copy **Client ID** và **Client Secret**
5. Trong n8n: Settings → Credentials → New Credential → Gmail OAuth2 API → Paste Client ID/Secret
6. Save → **Copy Credential ID** (dạng số, ví dụ: `123`)
7. Dán Credential ID vào 2 node: **Gmail Trigger** và **Gmail Send Reply** (thay `YOUR_GMAIL_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_ID`)

### 2. Cấu hình Environment Variables (n8n Settings → Variables)
| Variable | Mô tả | Ví dụ |
|---|---|---|
| `BASE_URL` | Base URL của Business Ops API | `http://host.docker.internal:8000` |
| `API_KEY` | Giá trị header `X-API-Key` (phải khớp `.env` API_KEY) | `sk-live-xxxxx` |
| `GMAIL_SENDER_EMAIL` | (Tùy chọn) Email gửi reply, mặc định dùng email của OAuth account | `support@yourdomain.com` |

### 3. Import & Activate Workflow
1. n8n UI → Workflows → Import from File → Chọn `gmail-inbound-reply.json`
2. Mở workflow → Thay `YOUR_GMAIL_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_ID` bằng Credential ID thực tế
3. Set Environment Variables (bước 2)
4. Click **Activate** (góc trên phải)

### 4. Test Checklist
- [ ] Gửi email test đến inbox Gmail đã kết nối
- [ ] Kiểm tra n8n Executions: workflow chạy mỗi phút, thấy email mới
- [ ] Kiểm tra API logs: `POST /v1/conversations` → 201, `POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages` → 200
- [ ] Kiểm tra response có `actions` với `mode: "SENT"` hoặc `"DRAFT"`
- [ ] Nếu có action SENT/DRAFT → Gmail Send Reply node chạy, người gửi nhận reply
- [ ] Kiểm tra thread Gmail: reply nằm cùng thread (threadId conserved)

### 5. Lưu ý quan trọng
- Workflow chỉ xử lý email **chưa đọc** (unread) trong INBOX
- Mỗi email tạo 1 conversation mới (channel: "email")
- Agent reply được gửi tự động **chỉ khi** tool `send_email_reply` trả về `mode: "SENT"` hoặc `"DRAFT"`
- X-Request-ID dùng `gmail_message_id` để trace audit log
- Nếu API trả về lỗi → execution fail, n8n retry theo policy

## 🔧 Flow Logic

```
Gmail Trigger (poll unread)
        ↓
Extract Email Data (Function)
  → from_email, subject, body, conversation_payload
        ↓
POST /v1/conversations {channel: "email", subject}
  → returns {conversation_id, ...}
        ↓
POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages {content: body}
  → returns {assistant_reply, actions[]}
        ↓
IF actions.some(a => a.mode === 'SENT' || a.mode === 'DRAFT')
  ├── YES → Gmail Send Reply (to from_email, threadId conserved)
  └── NO  → End (no auto-reply needed)
```

**Key Contract (apps/api/routes/conversations.py):**
- `ConversationCreateRequest`: `{channel: "email", subject?: string}`
- `ConversationCreateResponse`: `{conversation_id: UUID, ...}`
- `MessageCreateRequest`: `{content: string}`
- `MessageCreateResponse`: `{assistant_reply: string, actions: ActionMetadata[]}`
- `ActionMetadata`: `{tool, arguments, result, mode?: string}`  ← check `mode === "SENT" || "DRAFT"`

meta.description: Phase 3 Gmail inbound auto-reply: polls unread emails → creates conversation → appends message → if agent returns SENT/DRAFT action → replies via Gmail. ADR-003 compliant: no business logic in nodes.
